decision.explanation: The documents present conflicting claims about the birth date of the Cardinal of Guise. The first two documents refer to Louis I, Cardinal of Guise, who was born on 21 October 1527. The latter four documents refer to Louis II, Cardinal of Guise, who was born on 6 July 1555. These are distinct individuals with the same title, so both dates are valid within their respective contexts.
